hook.line: When you explain something in an essay, you define terms and say what things are made of. A few set phrases do that work, and they sound far more written than plain *es*.
hook.es: El proceso consta de tres fases.
hook.en: The process consists of three stages.

examples.es: Se entiende por economía informal el conjunto de actividades que no están reguladas por el Estado.
examples.en: The informal economy is understood as the set of activities that are not regulated by the state.

examples.es: El proceso consta de tres fases.
examples.en: The process consists of three stages.

examples.es: El jurado se compone de cinco miembros.
examples.en: The jury is made up of five members.

examples.es: Algunos animales hibernan; es el caso del oso.
examples.en: Some animals hibernate; this is the case with the bear.

examples.es: Se entiende por vivienda digna aquella que tiene agua y luz.
examples.en: Decent housing is understood as housing that has water and electricity.

examples.es: Esta encuesta consta de diez preguntas.
examples.en: This survey consists of ten questions.

rule:
Four phrases for explaining:
*Se entiende por* + term + definition: the term comes right after *por*.
*Consta de* + the parts: what something consists of.
*Se compone de* + the parts: what it is made up of.
*Es el caso de* + example: the example that proves your point.

Both *constar* and *componerse* take *de* before the parts. Do not add *es* after *se entiende por*: the term simply follows.
smallPrint: Teachers call these the expository toolkit: defining, classifying and exemplifying. *Se entiende* is the impersonal *se* ("it is understood").

readAndPick.es: El proceso consta de tres fases.
options: The process lasts three stages.
The process consists of three stages.
The process is the case of three stages.

readAndPick.es: Se entiende por vivienda digna aquella que tiene agua y luz.
options: Decent housing is understood as one that has water and electricity.
Decent housing is bought with water and electricity.
Someone understands decent housing.
The bear is the owner of it.
The bear is the cause of it.
That is the case with the bear.

readAndPick.es: El jurado se compone de cinco miembros.
options: The jury is made up of three members.
The jury is made up of five members.
The jury has put together five members.

readAndPick.es: Esta encuesta consta de diez preguntas.
options: This survey consists of ten questions.
This survey answers ten questions.
This survey consists of ten answers.

readAndPick.es: Se entiende por economía informal el conjunto de actividades no reguladas.
options: Informal economy is regulated by a set of activities.
A set of unregulated activities is understood as the informal economy.
The informal economy is understood as a set of unregulated activities.

readAndPick.es: Algunos animales hibernan; es el caso del oso.
options: Some animals hibernate; the bear is a case in point.
Some animals hibernate; the bear is their case.
Some animals hibernate because of the bear.

readAndPick.es: El café se compone de dos salas.
options: The café is made up of two rooms.
The café composes two rooms.
The café is made up of one room.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick *consta de* or *se entiende por* and type the whole sentence: *El proceso ___ tres fases.*
yourTurn.answer: El proceso consta de tres fases.
accept: El proceso se compone de tres fases.
yourTurn.why: Listing parts calls for *consta de* (or *se compone de*).

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: The jury is made up of five members.
yourTurn.answer: El jurado se compone de cinco miembros.
accept: El jurado consta de cinco miembros.
yourTurn.why: *Se compone de* + the parts says what the jury is made of.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: This survey consists of ten questions.
yourTurn.answer: Esta encuesta consta de diez preguntas.
accept: Esta encuesta se compone de diez preguntas.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: Decent housing is understood as housing that has water and electricity.
yourTurn.answer: Se entiende por vivienda digna aquella que tiene agua y luz.
accept: Se entiende por vivienda digna la que tiene agua y luz.
yourTurn.why: The term follows *por* directly, with no *es*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: That is the case with the bear.
Make it plural: *El proceso consta de una fase.* Say: The processes consist of three stages.
yourTurn.answer: Los procesos constan de tres fases.
accept: Los procesos se componen de tres fases.
yourTurn.why: Several processes, so the verb is plural: *constan*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: The café is made up of two rooms.
yourTurn.answer: El café se compone de dos salas.
accept: El café consta de dos salas.
yourTurn.why: Parts of a thing: *se compone de* + the parts.

pitfalls.wrong: El proceso consiste de tres fases.
pitfalls.right: El proceso consta de tres fases.
pitfalls.why: Almost. *Consistir* takes *en* and explains what something involves; for listing parts, use *constar de*.

pitfalls.wrong: Se entiende por economía informal es el conjunto de actividades.
pitfalls.right: Se entiende por economía informal el conjunto de actividades.
pitfalls.why: Almost. After *se entiende por*, the term goes straight into the definition without *es*.

pitfalls.wrong: El jurado se compone en cinco miembros.
pitfalls.right: El jurado se compone de cinco miembros.
pitfalls.why: Almost. *Componerse* takes *de*, not *en*, before the parts.

personal: Define one word from your own work or hobbies, starting with *Se entiende por*.
